initial_scale: RMS of rolling causal forecast residuals at common target times wholly inside the training prefix. All methods receive identical initial scales.
comparison: Primary prespecified candidate blend_50 against horizon and shortest, per scenario and lead, path-paired proper interval-score differences with pointwise 95% Monte Carlo t intervals. Every configured method and stress scenario reported. Any invalid score invalidates the entire score group, without dropping paths. Secondary fixed weight sensitivity is descriptive, not a tuned or optimal choice.
scope: Fixed half blending selected during three disjoint engineering pilots; no claim of an independent discovery study. Full seeds exactly equal the untouched full profile prespecified for pilot-03 and are disjoint from all pilot seeds. Forecaster, initial scales, q rates and DGPs unchanged. No parameter tuning after full results.
blended_rule: Own-lead mature EWMA RMS and shortest-lead EWMA RMS times fixed initial training ratios, linearly blended with constant short-source weights. Default candidate weight 0.5; 0.25 and 0.75 prespecified secondary sensitivity cases. The q controller and mature-label clock are identical; no weight learning or q clipping.

selection_history.retained: constant half-weight ablation; learned weights are excluded from public API
